correctness.rationale: The weighted coin cost h(t)=ceil(3t/5) is proved by sharp lower bound and five constructive residue cases. Monotonicity proves the full Apéry formula for all m>=6. The generator-wrap analysis reduces PF maximality to three explicit local inequalities and produces the exact I_m; residue checks prove the five-period type. Independent Dijkstra and brute gap/PF verification succeeded at the stated finite ranges. The proof, not enumeration, supplies all quantifiers.

value.rationale: The generators are the first four of the natural odd-step closure pattern, and for even m the first four minimal generators of the full Ore semigroup. Their truncation is a natural fixed-embedding-dimension subproblem. The complete PF spectrum determines type and an infinite arithmetic progression of symmetric parameters, a substantive local structure not a table interpolation or arbitrary finite slice.
